description: This file defines a DenseNet backbone class and a function to create a RetinaNet model with a DenseNet backbone, including methods for downloading pre-trained weights and validation.

classes.name: DenseNetBackbone
classes.description: Class representing a DenseNet backbone with utility methods for model creation, weight downloading, validation, and image preprocessing.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Constructs a RetinaNet model using a DenseNet backbone with specified parameters.

methods.name: download_imagenet
methods.description: Downloads pre-trained ImageNet weights for the specified DenseNet backbone.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the backbone string is correct and within allowed options.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Prepares an input image for processing by the network.
